# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({                                                              # Suppress startup messages for cleaner logs
  library(dplyr)                                                                # Load dplyr for data manipulation
  library(methyLImp2)                                                           # Load methyLImp2 for DNA methylation imputation functions
})                                                                              # End suppressed library loading block


base_dir <- "../../.."                                                          # Define project base directory relative to script location
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION")                # Define harmonization analysis directory
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "R")                                        # Define directory containing helper R scripts
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data_CN_only/preprocessing/FHS")           # Define directory for processed Framingham data

source(file.path(code_dir, "dnam_impute_functions.R"), local = TRUE)            # Source imputation helper functions
```

# Load Data

## Load Data

```{r load_probes}
dnam_data <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_beta.RDS"))                      # Load previously QC-filtered DNAm SummarizedExperiment

pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                       # Extract phenotype metadata
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                           # Access column metadata
  as.data.frame()                                                               # Convert to data frame

probe_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                       # Extract probe metadata
  SummarizedExperiment::rowData() %>%                                           # Access row metadata
  as.data.frame() %>%                                                           # Convert to data frame
  dplyr::rename(cpg = "Name") %>%                                               # Rename 'Name' column to 'cpg' for consistency with downstream code
  dplyr::filter(!(.data$seqnames %in% c("chrM", "chrX", "chrY")))               # Remove mitochondrial, X chromosome, and Y chromosome probes (retain only autosomal chromosomes 1-22)
dnam_data <- dnam_data[probe_df$cpg, ]                                          # Subset methylation data to retain only autosomal probes identified above
```

## Load Target Probes

```{r load_detp}
detp_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "detectionP_Failures.csv")) %>%         # Read CSV file containing detection p-value failure information
  dplyr::filter(.data$cpg %in% probe_df$cpg) %>%                                # Keep only detection failures for autosomal probes retained in previous step
  dplyr::filter(.data$sample %in% pheno_df$sample) %>%                          # Keep only detection failures for samples present in the methylation dataset
  dplyr::filter(.data$detp >= 0.01)                                             # Retain only failed measurements where detection p-value is >= 0.01 (indicating poor quality signal)
```

# Run Impute

## Impute Probes in Batches

```{r impute_run}
batches <- dnam_data %>%                                                        # Begin pipeline to identify unique batch identifiers
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                           # Extract column metadata from SummarizedExperiment object
  as.data.frame() %>%                                                           # Convert to data frame for manipulation
  dplyr::pull("Batch") %>%                                                      # Extract the 'Batch' column as a vector
  unique()                                                                      # Get unique batch identifiers to process separately
  
dnam_data <- impute_batches(dnam_data, detp_df, batches)                        # Impute missing values within each batch separately using custom function (accounts for batch-specific patterns)

```

## Filter Detection P

```{r filter_detp}
pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                       # Extract phenotype metadata
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                           # Access column metadata
  as.data.frame()                                                               # Convert to data frame

detp_df <- get_na_targets(pheno_df, detp_df)                                    # Update detection failure dataframe to identify remaining missing values that require imputation

```

## Impute Together

```{r impute_run_full}
beta_data <- get_beta_data(dnam_data, detp_df)                                  # Extract beta value matrix and prepare for imputation (marks remaining failures as NA)
probe_df <- get_probe_df(dnam_data)                                             # Extract updated probe annotation dataframe with chromosome information

beta_data <- impute_beta_nobatch(beta_data, probe_df)                           # Impute remaining missing values across entire dataset without batch separation (for values not imputed in batch-specific step)
dnam_data <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(                        # Reconstruct SummarizedExperiment object with imputed data
  assays = list(dnam = t(beta_data)),                                           # Create assay list with transposed beta matrix (transpose to restore original dimensions: probes × samples)
  rowData = dnam_data %>%                                                       # Preserve original row metadata (probe annotations)
    SummarizedExperiment::rowData() %>%                                         # Extract row metadata from original object
    as.data.frame(),                                                            # Convert to data frame
  colData = dnam_data %>%                                                       # Preserve original column metadata (sample phenotypes)
    SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                         # Extract column metadata from original object
    as.data.frame()                                                             # Convert to data frame
)                                                                               # End of SummarizedExperiment reconstruction

```

# Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(dnam_data, file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_imputed.RDS"))                     # Save final beta-value DNAm object
```
